releaseNotes: Get the latest update. The new PayPal app that you know and love, now made simpler, faster and easier to use. Continue to shop, pay, earn rewards, and manage your money. All in one place.
description:
There's never been a better time to check out PayPal, the trusted way to pay. The PayPal app now lets you shop, pay, earn PayPal+ points, and manage your money. All in one place, with confidence and Buyer Protection on your eligible purchases.*
*Buyer Protection is available on eligible purchases only. Time limits and other terms apply. See the Buyer Protection section of your local User Agreement for more information.

SEND & RECEIVE MONEY
A simple, secure way to quickly send & receive money to friends and family. With encryption technology, we go the distance to help make sure your money transfers are secure.
*PayPal account required to send, receive money. Fees apply for currency conversion and non-GBP international transfers. See fees: https://www.paypal.com/uk/money-hub/article/how-to-collect-money

IT’S LOYALTY FOR ALL. AND IT’S ALL FOR FREE
PayPal+ is the rewards programme built to give you more points in more ways. Use them just about anywhere you shop online. And it’s all for free with no fees or caps. Get started in the app.*
*Rewards are earned as points under the PayPal+ rewards programme. To earn, you must be enrolled in PayPal+. Eligible purchases only. PayPal+ T&Cs apply.

MULTIPLY YOUR POINTS WITH THE PAYPAL DEBIT CARD
Earn up to 10x PayPal+ points when you pay with your PayPal Debit Card, everywhere Mastercard® is accepted. Add it to your mobile wallet, use it in stores, and at PayPal checkout to watch your points grow*
*Set up and activation required. T&Cs apply.

BUY NOW, PAY LATER
Keep track of all your PayPal Pay in 3 and Pay in 30 repayments* Plus, earn points whenever you use Pay in 3 or Pay in 30.
*Credit agreement. Consider if the purchase is affordable and how you will repay. Missing payments may make other borrowing more difficult or more expensive. Eligibility subject to status and approval. 18+ UK residents only. See product terms for more details. Available for eligible purchases of £20 to £3000 for Pay in 3 and £1 to £900 for Pay in 30.

SEND MONEY GLOBALLY
Send money to friends and family abroad in over 110 countries – or get even more delivery options with Xoom.*
*Fees and restrictions apply. Transaction, currency conversion, and other fees may apply.

MANAGE YOUR SUBSCRIPTIONS
Keep track of your different subscriptions at the subscription hub. Easily view, update, or cancel subscriptions, while enjoying updates on recurring payments. Manage recurring payments all in one place.

POOL MONEY TOGETHER
Collect money in advance for group gifts, shared experiences, and more and skip the hassle of reimbursement afterward.*
*A PayPal account is required to create a Pool. T&Cs apply.

PayPal UK Ltd is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) as an electronic money institution (firm reference number 994790); in relation to its regulated consumer credit activities (firm reference number 996405); and for the provision of cryptocurrency services (firm reference number 1000741). Some products and services, such as PayPal Working Capital, are not regulated by the FCA and may offer a lower level of protection. Please read product terms for further details.
